aggregation.E1_Q1_NOT_READY: No admissible scope or common governance/provenance violation
aggregation.E1_Q1_PARTIAL_ONLY: Some hard-gate-passing evidence but minimum coverage/synthesis or required outputs incomplete
aggregation.E1_Q1_READY: All 168 candidate scopes satisfy every applicable criterion; all modalities/families/projects covered; complete local/global and heterogeneity outputs
aggregation.E1_Q1_READY_WITH_PREDECLARED_LIMITATIONS: All admitted scopes pass hard gates; minimum limited synthesis coverage met for every claimed modality; deficits/instability disclosed without universal claims

coverage_minimum_for_limited_synthesis: >=3 projects each with >=3 comparable families per claimed modality; cross-project stability still requires inherited >=11 pass and <=1 reversal
matrix_rule: PASS requires criterion fully met; PASS_WITH_LIMITATION only predeclared coverage/stability limits; FAIL for unmet required gate; NOT_APPLICABLE only logically absent diagnostic, never missing data
scope_minimum: >=3 global rows; >=1 local row per nonempty predicted class (max8); exact small-population counts disclosed
